event.title: 5th Annual King Juan Cup
event.summary: A one-day 5v5 co-ed youth soccer tournament in Bellevue, WA. Founded 2022 by soccer dads in Sammamish.

venue.name: Cherry Crest Elementary School
venue.notes: Main field divided into 4 game fields. Main lot ~40 spots; carpool. Check in at the Warriors (LW) tent.

rules.gameFormat: 5v5 co-ed, no goalkeeper, small POD goals. 15-minute halves, running clock, unlimited substitutions.
rules.advancement: Top 2 teams in each group advance.
rules.roster: 5 players minimum, 8 maximum. One play-up player from the older age group allowed for friendship only.
rules.conduct: No cards. Repeated unsportsmanlike conduct means sitting out the rest of that game. No slide tackles. No blocking the goal within 3 ft / 1 m.
